## Project instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root (and the `AGENTS.md` of the folder you work in). It describes the
project, how to run and test it with Docker only (values in `.env`), the FR/EN and theme rules, the caching and
disk-space rules, and the definition of done.
